title: USS Bonhomme Richard (LHD 6) Assists in Capsized ROK Ferry Search and Rescue Efforts
description: EAST CHINA SEA (April 18, 2014) Sailors aboard USS Bonhomme Richard (LHD 6) stand watches at forward lookout positions and in the pilot house while an MH-60S Sea Hawk helicopter, assigned to Helicopter Sea Combat Squadron (HSC) 25 is sent out to on a search and rescue mission. Sailors and Marines aboard of the forward-deployed amphibious assault ship USS Bonhomme Richard are conducting search and rescue operations as requested by the Republic of Korea Navy near the scene of the sunken ferry Sewol in the vicinity of the island of Jindo. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Christian Senyk/Released)
